title: Independently audit #6551’s retirement cut and Gaussian invoice delta
body:
Independently checks Ali Romman’s #6551 retirement boundary and complete Gaussian invoice change against #6545. The construction and gain remain predecessor contributions.

Both 35-field callers pass all 1,225 endpoint coefficients. A separate exact four-fiber checker confirms retirement-cut isolation. Literal tree/event accounting reproduces Δ(T−P)=208(H41−H40−H57+H56), positive for H_r=r^t, 0<t<1. Two additional ordinary translations are counted.

[Package, proofs, logs and review](https://github.com/DLamdata/integer-mult-bounds/tree/13e880a734cc03f2a52c82a412a9a0e6ac2b1f0c/research/pr6551-retirement-audit) · [Canonical Discussion](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5645#discussioncomment-19369687)

- Base/latest checked upstream: 7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a; priority revision 8.
- Contribution: 13e880a734cc03f2a52c82a412a9a0e6ac2b1f0c; four commits ahead of that base.
- #6551: 11ca568cd1a16776ade02b4df09ea04a784cc674.

Reproduce with `python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/pr6551-retirement-audit`.

Normal/optimized verification, 22 semantic rejection controls, three external corruption controls, committed-byte/history checks and both read-only Git-free exports pass. Separate AI accounting and skeptical review found no unresolved blocker; a source-navigation error was corrected.

No new κ, supplier admission or frontier change is claimed. Native/all-width realization, physical ordinary rates, numerical crossing, completion tails, compiler and outer predicates remain unaudited here. All five framework assumptions remain.

Next: independently audit the changed completion-tail parameters. Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance is disclosed; this is not human or formal-kernel verification. Predecessor credit, notices and Apache-2.0 licensing are preserved.
